Unfortunately, please note that the reservation remains unconfirmed as we have not yet received the payment.

Additionally, if you arrive after 9:00 PM, an additional late check-in fee of AED 500 will apply, as we will need to arrange for one of our agents to assist you with the check-in process outside of our regular operating hours.

We kindly recommend completing the payment before 9:00 PM to secure your reservation and avoid any additional charges
